ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low white-to-black ratio. Approximately 92% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface with high-intensity (white) clusters limited to the distal tips and scattered surface spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black contiguous region across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white clusters (approx. 30-50 pixels wide) located at the extreme lateral tips. Sparse circular white spots (3-8 pixels diameter) scattered across the right lobe and center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an interior vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees. Notable asymmetry present with a secondary smaller notch on the inner right lobe boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile. Left lobe features roughly 14 distinct jagged peaks. Right lobe features a more erratic topography with deep valleys and approximately 10 primary peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge sweep on both lobes, tapering into sharp, textured points at the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density white clusters (barnacle colonies) at both fluke tips. Several circular ring-like marks (3-5 distinct units) visible on the right lobe in the upper-right quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear white pixel streaks visible on the left lobe mid-section and the lower central keel area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular secondary notch/indentation located on the right side of the median notch. Heavy barnacle colonization on distal lateral margins.
